title: This Train Has Zero Crash Deaths in 60 Years and Runs 24 Seconds Late
subject: bullet train

scenes.text: This train has never killed a passenger in a crash.
No deaths from collisions, derailments or fires. Ever.
Its average delay in 2016 was just 24 seconds, storms and quakes included.
An earthquake alarm system brakes the trains automatically.

description:
This train has never killed a passenger in a crash.
The Shinkansen has carried over 10 billion passengers since 1964 with no collision, derailment or fire deaths, and averaged 24 seconds late in 2016.
Would your local train survive that standard?
first_comment: What's the most punctual transport you've ever taken?
